title: UAAP: Peter Osang delivers as UST dumps UE, boosts Final Four bid

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines- Peter Osang made an impressive debut as University of Santo Tomas routed University of the East, 97-70, to strengthen its Final Four bid in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Wednesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. UST fielded the 6-foot-7 Nigerian in place of Akowe, and Osang responded with 19 points on 7-of-10 shooting, 10 rebounds, five blocks and two assists in 28 minutes. “That’s part of [the decision], the matchup with UE.
